metadata.title: Spectral networks
metadata.authors_raw: Davide Gaiotto,1 Gregory W. Moore2 and Andrew Neitzke3
metadata.abstract: We introduce new geometric objects called spectral networks. Spectral net- works are networks of trajectories on Riemann surfaces obeying certain local rules. Spec- tral networks arise naturally in four-dimensional N = 2 theories coupled to surface defects, particularly the theories of class S. In these theories spectral networks provide a useful tool for the computation of BPS degeneracies: the network directly determines the degen- eracies of solitons living on the surface defect, which in turn determine the degeneracies for particles living in the 4d bulk. Spectral networks also lead to a new map between ﬂat GL(K, C) connections on a two-dimensional surface C and ﬂat abelian connections on an appropriate branched cover Σ of C. This construction produces natural coordinate sys- tems on moduli spaces of ﬂat GL(K, C) connections on C, which we conjecture are cluster coordinate systems. arXiv:1204.4824v2 [hep-th] 6 Oct 2013
